name: Behalf.bot - VCL runner
description: Runs a student's queued Vibecode Lisboa Hub jobs on their own install, through the local `claude -p` on their own Claude plan, instead of on an API key. A heartbeat claims each job from the Hub, runs every step with no tools in an empty directory, and posts the raw answers back; the Hub builds every prompt and checks every answer. Ships no course content: the skill and prompts arrive with each job. A tablet_send job skips claude and uploads a reading file the Hub built to the student's reMarkable with rmapi; a tablet_pull job reads the student's highlights and handwriting back off it for the Hub.

enabled.description: Master switch. The runner also does nothing until `vcl-runner setup` has stored an agent key.

agent_base_url.description: Hub the runner claims jobs from. Override only to test against a staging or local Hub; plain http is accepted for localhost only. Exported as FOUNDER_OS_AGENT_BASE_URL.

agent_key.description: The vcl_fos_ agent key from the Hub settings (runner: My BehalfBot). Empty (the default) means the runner does nothing. Set it with `vcl-runner setup`, which writes FOUNDER_OS_AGENT_KEY to the install's .env (the file the dispatcher sources before every gather); never put it in chassis.config.yaml or any committed file. Deliberately not in contracts.env, so an activation-time export of an empty value can never shadow the real key.

activation._note: The one scheduled job is the vcl-runner heartbeat, and it is opt-in twice: it must be added to the install's HEARTBEATS.md (block in README.md), and it does nothing until `vcl-runner setup` has stored an agent key. The gate does the work itself: with nothing queued it is one HTTP request and zero tokens, and the dispatcher's own model fires only when the key is rejected or the claude CLI is missing.

system.name: python3
system.install: apt-get install python3 (Debian) / your platform's package manager

system.name: claude
system.install: Claude Code, installed and logged in on the account that runs the heartbeat (run `claude` once)
system._explanation: Every job step runs through `claude -p` on the student's own login.

system.name: rmapi
system.install: rmapi (github.com/ddvk/rmapi), on PATH or named by RMAPI_BIN, paired once by running `rmapi` in a terminal as the account that runs the heartbeat (README: reMarkable)
system._explanation: Optional. Only for tablet_send jobs, which the Hub queues only when the student turned on reMarkable in the Hub. Without it those jobs post "rmapi not found"; every other job is unaffected.

system.name: rmscene
system.install: pip install 'rmscene>=0.6,<1' (github.com/ricklupton/rmscene, MIT). Already in the BehalfBot image.
system._explanation: Optional. Only for tablet_pull jobs: it parses the reMarkable v6 page files. Without it those jobs post "pull failed: rmscene not installed"; every other job is unaffected. Imported only when a pull runs.

network_egress: agent_base_url (https://vibecodelisboa.com by default) - GET /api/founder-os/agent/jobs/next and POST /api/founder-os/agent/jobs/:id/result on each heartbeat tick, only when an agent key is set
agent_base_url again for a tablet_send job - GET the job's file_url, refused unless it is on the same scheme, host and port as agent_base_url

agent_base_url again for a tablet_pull job - POST the document's PDF and one PNG per handwritten page to the job's document_url and pages_url, refused unless they are on the same scheme, host and port as agent_base_url
the reMarkable cloud, through rmapi, for tablet_send and tablet_pull jobs only
_declares.credentials: FOUNDER_OS_AGENT_KEY, read from the environment only and sent only as the Bearer header to agent_base_url (a tablet_send file_url or a tablet_pull upload URL on any other origin is refused before any request, and a redirect off that origin is followed without the key). Never logged, never passed to the claude or rmapi child process. rmapi keeps its own reMarkable token in its own config file; the runner never reads it. The runner never reads ~/.claude, the keychain or any OAuth credential: it starts the claude CLI the student already logged into, with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY removed from the child's environment so the work bills the student's Claude plan.
_declares.subprocesses: claude -p --output-format json --tools "" --strict-mcp-config --setting-sources "" --disable-slash-commands --no-session-persistence --append-system-prompt <skill> [--model <model>], prompt on stdin, in an empty temporary directory. No tools and no MCP servers. For a tablet_send job only: rmapi -ni mkdir <folder> and rmapi -ni put <file> <folder>, stdin closed, so an unpaired rmapi exits instead of waiting for a code. For a tablet_pull job only: rmapi -ni stat <doc_path> and rmapi -ni get <doc_path> (in a temporary directory), stdin closed.
filesystem: ${CUSTOMER_HOME}/.env (and .env.baked when present) - written by `vcl-runner setup` only, mode 0600
a temporary empty directory per claude call, removed afterwards
a temporary directory holding the downloaded file for a tablet_send job, removed afterwards
a temporary directory holding the downloaded document for a tablet_pull job, removed afterwards
